options.description: Whether imported XML may overwrite mapped cells (valid for: import-xml)

options.name: --range
options.description: Target cell or single-column range (required for:  map-range) (valid for: map-range)

options.name: --repeating
options.description: Whether to create a repeating XML list mapping (valid  for: map-range)

options.name: --root-element-name
options.description: Optional root element when the schema has multiple  roots (valid for: add)

options.description: XSD schema content. Public callers must supply either  inline schema or a readable schemaFile, not both. (required for: add) (valid  for: add)

options.name: --schema-file
options.description: Path to a readable file containing schema; use instead of inline schema, not together (valid for: add)

options.name: --selection-namespace
options.description: Optional namespace declarations used by prefixed XPath expressions (valid for: map-range)

options.name: --session

options.name: --start-cell

options.name: --xml-data
